content.text: {"summary":"The network was examined along the velocity axis with q=0 and u=0. Near v=0 its slope with respect to v is about -0.72 over roughly v in [-0.49, 0.67]. The slope grows steeper at larger |v|, which matches the quadratic drag term. So the linear damping coefficient is c ≈ 0.72, and this estimate is approximate. To add -c*v, I used hidden unit 1, which was unused (all-zero row). Its pre-activation is v+1, which stays positive on the domain, so the unit acts linearly there. Its output weight is -0.72, and b2 is raised by 0.72 to cancel the constant offset. All other units are unchanged, so restoring, drag and action responses are preserved.","estimated_c":0.72,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[1,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"b1","index":[1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[1],"value":-0.72},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":0.52393424}]}
